meta.name: paper-search-usage
meta.description: This skill should be used when user asks to "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", "search PubMed", "find academic papers", "search IEEE", "search Scopus", or "look up scientific literature".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并查找学术论文与科学文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查找学术论文或科学文献
copy.tagline_en: Search and find academic papers and scientific literature
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find academic papers or scientific literature

howto.what: 装上后，当你说出搜索论文相关指令时，Claude 会调用多个学术平台（如 arXiv、PubMed、IEEE 等）搜索论文，并返回结果。
howto.when: 当你要求“搜索论文”、“查找研究论文”、“搜索 arXiv”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下关于机器学习的论文
say.note: Claude 会在支持平台上搜索

say.text: 在PubMed上找新冠相关的文章
搜索arXiv上近期的量子计算预印本

howto.what_en: When you ask to search for papers, Claude will use this skill to search across multiple academic platforms (e.g., arXiv, PubMed, IEEE) and return results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", etc.

say_en.text: Search for papers about machine learning
say_en.note: Claude will search across supported platforms

say_en.text: Find articles on COVID-19 in PubMed
say_en.note: Claude will limit search to PubMed

say_en.text: Look up recent preprints on quantum computing from arXiv
